stories.title: Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy, The Follow-Up To Rogue Trader, Gets Early 2027 Release Date
stories.summary: Warhammer: 40,000: Dark Heresy developer Owlcat Games has confirmed that the CRPG will officially launch on January 28, 2027, for PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X|S. A follow-up to the studio's previous—and lengthy—game, Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader, Dark Heresy will put players in the boots of an Inquisitor, one of the chosen few who work in the shadows to hunt down heretics and purge worlds of dark...

sources.name: Eurogamer
sources.title: Anticipated Warhammer 40K tactical RPG Dark Heresy gets a release date
sources.text: Owlcat Games has revealed a release date for its tactical role-playing sequel Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy. The game arrives 28th January, 2027 on PC, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series S/X. A Switch 2 release date will be provided "at a later date", a press release says. Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy follows the good work laid down by Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader a couple of years ago. "Rogue Trader nails the 40k setting and provides an appropriately massive narrative filled with meaty tactical combat, though some bugs and poor performance hold it back," wrote Caeyln Ellis in Eurogamer's Warhammer 40,000 Rogue Trade review . Dark Heresy changes things by casting you as an Inquisitor and tasking you with hunting down heretics and purging the world of dark influences, as one is wont to do in the 41st century, it seems. And developer Owlcat has apparently overhauled many of the systems underpinning the adventure. There's a beta that's been running for a while that offers a complete first Act to try, and it's accessible if you buy a Founders edition of the game. This beta, incidentally, disappears 7th January, when Owlcat prepares the game for launch. Meanwhile, Owlcat is making a substantially different RPG based around the popular Expanse license - a game that's much more closely inspired by Mass Effect . That project recently recruited the help of former Dragon Age writer David Gaider , and it will no doubt hope to fill a much-lamented hole created recently by the cancellation of Mass Effect 5 .

Gunn and Safran architected the new DC Universe of films and TV series, and they also had ambitious plans to expand the DCU into video games. Latcham is no stranger to superhero cinema, with credits on several of Marvel's biggest projects...

sources.title: James Gunn And Peter Safran Step Down As DC Studios Co-Presidents Two Years Into The DC Universe
sources.text: After only three DC Universe movies and three TV shows, James Gunn and Peter Safran are stepping down as co-presidents of DC Studios. âFour years ago, we set out to unite DC under one creative vision. In that time, we helped restore Superman to the heart of DC, while opening new doors and telling new stories in film and television with Peacemaker , Creature Commandos , Lanterns and Clayface ,â Gunn and Safran said in a statement to Variety . âWeâre immensely proud of the team that turned that ambition into something real, including the actors, crews and executives we had the opportunity to collaborate with. Weâve shared a creative history with Jeremy going back to Marvel, and weâre eager to see the perspective he brings to DCâs next chapter. Weâre excited to return to what drew us to this job in the first place, which is telling the stories we love, including the next chapter of Clark and Lexâs journey in Man of Tomorrow .â VarietyÂ reports that the pair will be replaced by Marvel veteran Jeremy Latcham, who has credits onÂ Guardians of the Galaxy ,Â Avengers , and Spider-Man films. âJeremy brings a deep reverence for DC and its passionate fanbase, recognizing that they are the very foundation of this storied, multigenerational brand,â said Skydance Motion Picture Group co-chairs Dana Goldberg and Josh Greenstein. âUnder his leadership, every film and television show will be ushered from start to finish through the prism of the legions of fans who love and champion it. Jeremyâs track record exemplifies the excellence he will bring to building out DC and the many beloved characters within it.â The shake-up is pretty unexpected given Gunn and Safran’s quest to get the DC cinematic universe on track had only really just begun. The pair formed DC Studios in 2022, and kicked off a new movie continuity for DC heroes with last year’s acclaimedÂ Superman . This year’sÂ Supergirl was not quite as well received and performed poorly at the box office .Â Clayface , a body horror film about the Batman villain of the same name, was released last month. On the TV side,Â Lanterns and Peacemaker were both received very well after debuting on HBO Max, though the DC Universe’s choices for some early projects had drawn a fair bit of criticism for focusing on obscure characters instead of major players like Batman and Wonder Woman. The People v. Gorilla GroddÂ is an upcoming mockumentary series starring Skyler Gisondo as Jimmy Olson after he debuted as the comic relief character in Superman . Gunn is still attached to next year’sÂ Man of Tomorrow , which he wrote and directed, but both he and Safran “will return full time to creative work” after years of overseeing the DCU’s direction. Update, 11/9/26, 1:15 p.m. Eastern:Â Gunn has released a statement on his Instagram account, confirming he is still working with DC on bothÂ Man of Tomorrow and another project he’s writing on. He leaves it open-ended on whether or not he’ll continue working with the company, saying “we’ll see where it goes after that.” Thanks to all of you who have supported me and Peter in our time as the heads of DC Studios. When I was a kid growing up in Manchester, Missouri, I used to write and draw my own comics with a mix of DC Comics characters and my own characters. Having full access to these characters to do whatever we wanted has been a dream come true. I didn’t know if I wanted this job when it was offered to me, but I just couldn’t pass up the unique opportunity. I’m glad I took the job. There have been so many highs along the way – releasing Superman and Clayface, making Peacemaker, reading the scripts to The People Vs, the entire process of Man of Tomorrow, which thus far has been the best filmmaking experience of my life, and numerous other moments. The highest of the highs have been all the talented and wonderful people I’ve worked with and grown to love: the DC Studios crew, our talented collaborators, our casts and crews, and the boisterous and hilarious fans. And the best part of all has been working with Peter Safran, the smartest and most competent person I know. You’ve been the best partner a person could ask for, and, more so, a truly good friend. But what only the closest people to me have known over the past four years is my time at DC Studios has been trying, to say the least. I dislike the at-times corporate nature of the job (thanks to Peter for taking the brunt of that). I’m always a very hard worker, but as a filmmaker I would at least get to take short breaks to unwind, and I’ve stolen even that time from both myself and my loved ones over the past four years (Jenn, I love you and I’m sorry and you don’t need to feel guilty for being the happiest of all people that I’m no longer doing this job). And the thing my ADHD hyperfocus has had the most difficulty with has been dividing my time between projects I’m incredibly passionate about and the ones I’m not so much and all the things I have to do as a studio head. So, yes, I will miss the people around me, and I will miss being the co-caretaker of these great characters, but I’m also incredibly relieved and excited to get back to pure filmmaking. That’s not to say Peter and 1 are immediately done with DC or superheroes. We have Man of Tomorrow out this summer. And we’ve just been engaged on another DC project which I’m writing, and we’ll see where it goes after that. And, of course, the characters we set up will live on. Thank you so very, very much for embracing the characters and stories we’ve put on screen. Donât miss the latest reviews, news and tips. Sign up for our free newsletter. sources.title: James Gunn is out at DC Studios, as former Marvel Studios executive takes over under Skydance
sources.text: James Gunn and Peter Safran are stepping down as co-heads of DC Studios and will be replaced by former Marvel executive Jeremy Latcham James Gunn and DC Studios co-CEO Peter Safran are stepping down as the heads of DC Studios and will be replaced by former Marvel Studios executive Jeremy Latcham. Per The Hollywood Reporter , Gunn and Safran are out of the job from December 1, 2026. That's just over four years after the pair were appointed to the post. In that time, DC Studios has released three movies ( Superman , Supergirl and Clayface ) and four TV shows (Creature Commandos, Peacemaker season 2 , The Penguin and Lanterns ). Projects currently in the pipeline include Superman sequel Man of Tomorrow , Jimmy Olsen series The People v. Gorilla Grodd, Creature Commandos season 2, and Elseworlds movie The Batman: Part II . “Four years ago, we set out to unite DC under one creative vision," Gunn and Safran said in a statement. "In that time, we helped restore Superman to the heart of DC, while opening new doors and telling new stories in film and television with Peacemaker, Creature Commandos, Lanterns and Clayface. "We’re immensely proud of the team that turned that ambition into something real, including the actors, crews and executives we had the opportunity to collaborate with. "We’ve shared a creative history with Jeremy going back to Marvel, and we’re eager to see the perspective he brings to DC’s next chapter," Gunn and Safran said of their replacement at DC Studios. "We're excited to return to what drew us to this job in the first place, which is telling the stories we love, including the next chapter of Clark and Lex’s journey in Man of Tomorrow." In a separate, longer statement on Threads , Gunn said he's "incredibly relieved and excited to get back to pure filmmaking" and noted "the characters we set up will live on". Latcham is Marvel Studios' former senior VP of production and development, and was Kevin Feige's right-hand man at the company for a time, with credits on Iron Man, The Avengers, Guardians of the Galaxy and Spider-Man: Homecoming. As with Gunn and Safran, Latcham will oversee DC's film, TV and animation slate. "James and Peter launched a new era for DC Studios and led it through a period of real transformation, resetting the foundation and building a slate we’re incredibly proud of," Skydance bosses David Ellison and Ynon Kreiz said in a statement . "We're grateful for their passion, contributions and commitment to this legendary brand." Subscribe for a weekly digest of the movie and TV news that matters, direct to your inbox. From first-look trailers, interviews, reviews and explainers, we’ve got you covered. What the future now holds for DC is now less clear than ever. While several projects from the Gunn and Safran era are still in the pipeline, many were critical of Gunn and Safran's decision not to launch their shared universe with big-hitters like Batman and Wonder Woman, and instead focus on lesser-explored characters like Supergirl and Clayface. Could a creative reboot be on the cards, despite Gunn's Superman movies still being an ongoing concern? We'll soon find out. Man of Tomorrow releases on July 9, 2027. For more, here's all the upcoming DC movies and shows announced before Gunn's departure. I'm the Managing Editor, Entertainment here at GamesRadar+, overseeing the site's film and TV coverage. In a previous life as a print dinosaur, I was the Deputy Editor of Total Film magazine, and the news editor at SFX magazine. Fun fact: two of my favourite films released on the same day - Blade Runner and The Thing. stories.title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Took Away Auto Jump, and Poor Link Is Paying the Price
stories.summary: For all of the changes in Nintendo's The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake, there's one that's tripping players up more than any of the others: a jump button.

sources.name: IGN
sources.title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Took Away Auto Jump, and Poor Link Is Paying the Price
sources.text: For all of the changes in Nintendo's The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake , there's one that's tripping players up more than any of the others: a jump button. If you've played Metacritic 's all-time highest-rated game in the 28 years since its Nintendo 64 release (or most other 3D Zelda games, for that matter), you'll know Hyrule's courageous protector doesn't need a button press to cross small gaps. What was once intuitive for the time has since been rendered obsolete, as Nintendo opted to give players the freedom to send Link a short distance into the air with the simple press of a button in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time for Switch 2. What sounds like an innocuous change on its face is, really, revolutionary for the company's decades-old fantasy franchise. For proof, you needn't look further than social media, as the remake's first weekend in players' hands was filled with examples of those who just can't get a handle on that one extra step. What Nintendo maybe didn't consider, though, is that poor, little Young Link has to pay for it. "I keep forgetting to press jump," one Reddit user said , sharing a clip of Link taking a dip in Kokiri Forest. "Same," another replied . "30 years of habit is hard to break." They're not alone; in fact, they're part of an ocean of players who turned on the Ocarina of Time remake and immediately started sending Link for a swim. As if there was ever any doubt, a fundamental change like this was bound to spawn disagreements. Considering it also happens to be a change for one of the most important game releases of all time, it's become a full-blown talking point for a good chunk of those who have picked up the remake since its Switch 2 launch last week. "Same but different reason," one player replied , "jump button being X feels unnatural to me." (Note: There is an option to switch jump from X to the B button in the settings.) "I actually think the auto-jump was one of the most interesting features of the original," someone else said , "particularly considering that people had barely figured out how to do 3D games. It is never not fun to just point Link towards a ledge and seeing him spontaneously do a little jump." Lo del salto manual en Ocarina of Time cómo lo llevan... https://t.co/bIoqEWLk1Y My muscle memory betrayed me and I forgot about the new jump button immediately 😭 https://t.co/85A2fQIpn5 the OoT remake experience https://t.co/lV7fb1SkkR Well, instead of doing a little jump, these days Link is taking little tumbles. Look, I feel everyone's pain. I'm not too far into the remake, but I've still had to watch Link plop into a river or fling himself into a boulder at least once after taking a break. Thankfully, Link usually won't take too much damage after a fall. Even if he does get caught tripping, the Ocarina of Time remake's new ragdoll physics at least make every mistake a little funny. Even if you're still upset there's no option for auto jump, you can't be nearly as bent out of shape as Link is. "I love how he just f**kin eats the side of the platform," one player joked . "The way he looked like he broke a rib and his jaw," another said . You can see some of what they're talking about below. For more, you can see why dataminers have fans hoping for Master Quest DLC – or maybe even a Majora's Mask remake . You can also read about the speedrunners who have managed to break the game in a few hilarious ways in less than a week . You can also read IGN's review of the game here , or check out our look at the Biggest Changes from the original 1998 game. sources.title: The Legend of Zelda Ocarina of Time Remake já roda a 60 FPS e ganha até multiplayer no PC
sources.text: O remake de The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time, lançado recentemente para Nintendo Switch 2, já está sendo executado em computadores por meio de emuladores. Poucas horas depois da estreia oficial, usuários conseguiram inicializar o jogo no PC, embora a experiência inicial fosse marcada por problemas gráficos, travamentos e desempenho instável. A situação, no entanto, mudou rapidamente. Apenas um dia depois das primeiras tentativas, atualizações dos emuladores Lichii e Eglantine já permitem executar o clássico da Nintendo a até 60 quadros por segundo (FPS), com melhorias significativas na qualidade visual e na estabilidade. Além disso, modders também já trabalham para trazer suporte para multiplayer ao game nos computadores. Até o momento, a Nintendo não comentou sobre o assunto, mas a situação pode levar a movimentações legais da companhia. De acordo com informações do DSOGaming , o emulador Lichii conseguiu corrigir boa parte dos problemas gráficos identificados no primeiro dia de testes. Regiões como a área inicial do jogo e a Árvore Deku já podem ser executadas a 60 FPS, contra os 20 a 30 FPS registrados nas primeiras tentativas. Relatos publicados por usuários também apontam resultados ainda melhores em algumas configurações. Um jogador afirmou ter conseguido executar o remake em 4K e 60 FPS estáveis, sem os principais problemas visuais observados anteriormente, embora pequenos travamentos e congelamentos ainda aconteçam. Outro teste, compartilhado na comunidade do emulador Eglantine, utilizou um processador Ryzen 7 5700X e uma placa de vídeo RTX 5070. O jogador conseguiu avançar até a obtenção da Espada Kokiri em um novo arquivo, mas ainda encontrou problemas de cintilação de texturas, iluminação e dessincronização de áudio em determinadas cenas. Parte da evolução aconteceu graças a mudanças específicas no funcionamento dos emuladores. O Lichii, que é baseado no Eglantine, recebeu correções para problemas que provocavam flashes brancos na tela, cenas completamente pretas e falhas na exibição da vegetação. Os desenvolvedores também trabalharam em otimizações de desempenho, incluindo melhorias no carregamento e armazenamento de shaders. Entre as mudanças estão o reaproveitamento de pipelines gráficos já compilados e a execução de determinadas tarefas em segundo plano durante a inicialização do jogo. O repositório do Eglantine mostra que a equipe publicou diferentes versões experimentais voltadas especificamente à compatibilidade com Ocarina of Time. Como resultado, o progresso tem sido bastante rápido, embora ainda existam limitações que podem variar conforme o hardware e a versão utilizada. Além de melhorar o desempenho do remake no PC, a comunidade de modders já começou a trabalhar em outro recurso: um modo multiplayer. Um vídeo publicado nesta segunda-feira (9) mostra uma versão preliminar da modificação em funcionamento no emulador Lichii, permitindo que jogadores compartilhem a aventura no clássico da Nintendo. O projeto ainda está em desenvolvimento e não possui previsão de lançamento. A expectativa é que a modificação também seja compatível com a versão não oficial do jogo para PC, embora isso ainda dependa de testes e ajustes dos responsáveis pelo projeto. O remake também chamou atenção por uma demonstração envolvendo tecnologias de upscaling. O canal ElAnalistaDeBits publicou uma comparação mostrando como o NVIDIA DLSS pode melhorar a qualidade da imagem do jogo em relação ao AMD FSR 1.0 utilizado originalmente. A demonstração utiliza uma técnica de injeção de DLSS via HDMI, em vez de alterar diretamente o funcionamento interno do jogo. Na comparação, a tecnologia da NVIDIA reduz efeitos de cintilação e melhora a definição de elementos da imagem. Vale lembrar que o Nintendo Switch 2 possui suporte ao DLSS, tecnologia que também já aparece em jogos de outras desenvolvedoras para o console. Mesmo assim, a Nintendo optou pelo FSR 1.0 em Ocarina of Time, uma escolha que chamou atenção diante das possibilidades oferecidas pelo hardware. A chegada do remake aos computadores com modificações também acontece em meio a uma nova onda de avanços na comunidade de emulação do Switch 2. Segundo os relatos, os arquivos do jogo começaram a circular antes do lançamento, após cópias físicas chegarem antecipadamente a alguns consumidores. The Legend of Zelda Ocarina of Time Remake vale a pena no Switch 2? Confira análise do jogo A extração dos arquivos estaria relacionada ao ns2jb, ferramenta de desbloqueio do console que se tornou pública recentemente. Pouco depois da divulgação do método, outros jogos exclusivos, como Mario Kart World, também começaram a inicializar em emuladores para PC e até mesmo em dispositivos da Apple. A Nintendo não comentou oficialmente sobre o caso, mas já estaria tomando medidas contra possíveis brechas utilizadas nesse processo. O aplicativo SmileBASIC 4, apontado como uma das portas de entrada para a exploração do sistema, foi removido da eShop. No passado, a empresa também tomou medidas legais contra desenvolvedores de emuladores em uma situação parecida. Após arquivos de Zelda Tears of the Kingdom vazarem antes do lançamento, a companhia iniciou movimentações contra o Yuzu em 2024 por pirataria . Logo, não seria surpreendente ver novas medidas contra ferramentas como Lichii e Eglantine. Em seu site, a Nintendo também deixa claro que é contra o uso de emuladores. A empresa vê os softwares como prejudiciais ao seu modelo de negócio. “Os emuladores não autorizados permitem que certos jogos sejam utilizados de formas não previstas originalmente pelos criadores e incentivam a utilização de cópias não autorizadas (ou seja, pirateadas) dos jogos”, diz a empresa. “Logo, os emuladores têm um impacto negativo na experiência de jogo dos usuários, nos investimentos realizados pelos criadores para desenvolver e publicar jogos únicos e inovadores e, assim, na indústria dos videogames em geral.” E aí, qual a sua opinião sobre o assunto? sources.title: How to get the Golden Scale in Zelda Ocarina of Time
sources.text: The Golden Scale is a unique item in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake that allows Link to dive deeper. You can consider it an upgrade to the Silver Scale, an item that you obtain as young Link as you try to find Princess Ruto . However, unlike the Silver Scale, you can only get the Golden Scale after becoming adult Link . If you would like to explore the depths of Hyrule and hunt for all the treasures hidden underwater, you should learn how to get the Golden Scale in the Ocarina of Time remake . You obtain the Golden Scale by catching a fish longer than 60 cm in the Fishing Pond . To complete the challenge, you must travel south of Hyrule Field to Lake Hylia as adult Link . You will see that the lake is dry, and you won't be able to reach the Fishing Pond, located on the right side of the map, on your own. You will need to either ride a magic bean plant (that you need to plant as child Link next to the laboratory) or play the Scarecrow Song near the bridge at the front of the building, and then use the Hookshot on to it. Lake Hylia will also be refilled once you clear the Water Temple , so you can come back after that, too. Once inside, talk to the Fishing-Pond Man and learn that you can earn a prize if "you catch a big enough fish." Rent a fishing rod for 30 rupees , allowing you to fish as many times as you want until you tell the Fishing-Pond Man that you're done. When preparing to cast your bait, we suggest that you aim at the middle of the pond where you can usually find big fish. Big fish are more difficult to reel in because they resist for longer periods. Just be patient and keep moving the rod in the direction the fish is pulling. If you catch a fish that is smaller than 60 cm, you just need to toss it back and keep trying until you find the right fish. However, if you get a fish that meets the requirements, keep it, and then go talk to the Fishing-Pond Man . Select the "I'm done" option and he will examine your fish, and you will receive the Golden Scale. The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake is a little bit different than the original game, so if you need guides to help you through, we don’t blame you. We have walkthroughs for all the dungeons, from the Deku Tree to Ganondorf's Castle . We also have guides for the sillier, in-between parts of the game, like when you have to find Richard (the dog) or Cuccos . For those going for 100% completion, we also have guides on where to find every Piece of Heart , every Gold Skulltula token , and where to plant every Magic Bean .

stories.title: Assassin’s Creed Valhalla: a atualização com novo jogo+, novo recurso e muito mais
stories.summary: The post Assassin’s Creed Valhalla: a atualização com novo jogo+, novo recurso e muito mais appeared first on Xbox Wire em Português .

sources.name: Xbox Wire BR
sources.title: Assassin’s Creed Valhalla: a atualização com novo jogo+, novo recurso e muito mais
sources.text: A atualização mais pedida de Assassin’s Creed Valhalla já está disponível no XBOX Series X|S e no XBOX One. A atualização traz diversas novidades empolgantes ao jogo, oferecendo novas maneiras de aproveitar sua aventura viking. O grande destaque é a chegada do Novo Jogo+, um dos recursos mais pedidos pelos fãs de Assassin’s Creed Valhalla . As demais novidades do patch garantem que sua experiência após o fim da campanha e no Novo Jogo+ seja renovada e desafiadora, com recompensas que fazem tudo valer a pena. Confira o que esperar da atualização mais pedida: Conversamos com o designer-chefe de jogo, David Larouche, para saber mais sobre a atualização e como a equipe coloca os jogadores no centro de tudo o que faz. Quais novidades desta atualização são uma resposta direta aos comentários da comunidade? David Larouche : o Novo Jogo+ foi, sem dúvida, o recurso mais pedido pelos fãs. Assassin’s Creed Valhalla é um jogo imenso, mas, para algumas pessoas, jogar uma vez só não basta. Com esta atualização, estamos muito empolgados em permitir que nossos vikings mais dedicados vivam essa aventura novamente, mas, desta vez, com o personagem que tinham ao final da campanha. Como a equipe garantiu que os recursos pedidos atendessem às expectativas dos jogadores? DL : queríamos que a experiência do Novo Jogo+ não fosse apenas jogar tudo de novo; queríamos permitir que os jogadores continuassem aumentando seu poder, percebessem uma progressão em etapas menores e seguissem aprimorando seus personagens. Por todos esses motivos, adicionamos um modo de progressão estendida, mais melhorias para todas as peças de equipamento divino, uma nova categoria de runas e mais de 300 novas opções de bônus de runas que podem ser gravados na Forja de Runas — e todos esses recursos também estão disponíveis fora do Novo Jogo+. Com todas essas novidades, acreditamos que a experiência do Novo Jogo+ incentivará os jogadores a explorar todo o potencial de Eivor. Houve algum desafio inesperado na implementação dessas novidades? DL : acho que o mais surpreendente para nós foi justamente não termos encontrado nenhum grande desafio que nos deixasse sem saber como avançar. Conseguimos reunir uma equipe muito competente de desenvolvedores com experiência em adicionar o Novo Jogo+ a jogos já existentes; o processo de produção foi incrivelmente tranquilo. Há algum recurso que você esteja especialmente empolgado para ver no jogo? DL : com a atualização, transformamos praticamente todos os bônus presentes em itens em runas que podem ser gravadas na Forja de Runas, independentemente de terem sido lançados na experiência estendida, em uma expansão ou até mesmo na Loja. Mal posso esperar para ver como os jogadores vão combinar todos esses bônus e criar os mais variados tipos de sinergia. Tenho certeza de que há muitas combinações poderosíssimas a serem descobertas! Assassin’s Creed Valhalla recebeu sua última atualização de conteúdo há anos. Por que lançar a atualização mais pedida para os jogadores agora? DL : Valhalla pode ter recebido sua última atualização de conteúdo há anos, mas isso não significa que os jogadores deixaram de se importar com o jogo — e nós também não. Sabemos que o Novo Jogo+ é algo que a comunidade deseja há muito tempo e, quando surgiu a oportunidade de finalmente torná-lo realidade, mal podíamos esperar para seguir em frente. No fim das contas, trata-se de dar aos jogadores de longa data mais um motivo para voltar a um mundo ao qual dedicaram tanto tempo e reviver a jornada de Eivor sob uma nova perspectiva, levando consigo boa parte do que conquistaram pelo caminho. O fato de algum tempo ter passado não torna essa experiência menos significativa para nós nem, esperamos, para nossos jogadores. Qual é a importância da comunidade de Assassin’s Creed para a equipe da franquia? DL : a comunidade é extremamente importante para mim e para a equipe. Pessoalmente, acompanho as redes sociais com frequência para ver sobre o que os jogadores estão conversando e, como equipe, prestamos muita atenção aos comentários e às conversas pela internet. Adoramos ver o que os jogadores criam e compartilham sobre nossos jogos. Essa conexão com a comunidade é incrivelmente gratificante e é uma das principais razões pelas quais fazemos o que fazemos. Jogue hoje mesmo Assassin’s Creed Valhalla com a atualização mais pedida no XBOX Series X|S e no XBOX One.

sources.title: Epic Games Launcher is coming to SteamOS
sources.text: Epic Games confirmed that its Linux launcher will officially support SteamOS and Steam Decks. Epic Games confirmed that its Linux launcher will officially support SteamOS and Steam Decks. In October, Epic Games said that it was “ investigating ” making Fortnite compatible with Valve’s Linux-based SteamOS. At the time, Epic Games Launcher was in preview, but SteamOS was not specifically listed as a supported distro. Now, Communications Director Jake Jones has confirmed SteamOS compatibility, along with a handful of other distros, to GamingOnLinux . In response to a question about the AppImage being replaced with Debian / Ubuntu .deb downloads, Jones said: “The new Epic Games Launcher is still in Preview and we plan to support as many Linux distributions as possible, including Fedora, SteamOS, Cachy, Omarchy, and more. We’re testing and evaluating packaging formats for distribution, and we’ll restore AppImage this month.” That doesn’t necessarily mean Fortnite will come to SteamOS. Easy Anti-Cheat (EAC) Linux v2 support still remains an open question. When it announced its work to bring Fortnite to Linux, the company said that the Steam Deck “does not support the required features for our EAC v2 solution, but we are actively talking with Valve and hope to support it in the future.”

sources.name: Eurogamer
sources.title: GTA 6 reportedly has 55 Achievements/Trophies, more than both GTA 5 and Red Dead Redemption 2 had at launch
sources.text: GTA 6 is due to release on the 19th November on PS5, and Xbox Series X/S, and ahead of the highly-anticipated launch of Rockstar's latest sandbox adventure, people just can't get enough information about the game. To that end, overnight, we saw our latest leak: the game will have 55 Trophies/Achievements. In a now-deleted tweet from (in)famous Rockstar dataminer, TexFunz2 - re-posted by the Twitter account iGrandTheftAuto - it appears the game will have 55 individual rewards for completing certain tasks and missions. At the time of writing, we don't know specifically what these challenges are, but it seems none of them will be attached to the online version of the game; the base game launches without GTA Online , and so we can safely assume that all these rewards will be for the single-player only content. GTA Online will drop sometime in 2027, according to Twitch's CEO . If you've been paying attention to previous Rockstar titles, you'll know that Grand Theft Auto 5 launched with 51 Achievements/Trophies - again, all single-player - and Red Dead Redemption 2 launched with 52. So the latest game has more than either game got at launch - and I can tell you from experience, getting Platinum in either title was a very time-consuming experience. Expect the same to be true here, too. It's worth highlighting that GTA 5 did, eventually, get more Achievements and Trophies: the GTA Online content upped the complete total to 78, adding 27 new challenges to complete. I would expect GTA 6 to do the same… whenever the PC version of GTA comes out, or GTA Online lands in the new game (it's possible both could happen at the same time). Recently, we heard why a former Rockstar Games tech director thinks GTA 6 could be coming to PC sooner than you'd expect (mostly thanks to AI clones), when we can expect the pre-load of the game (10th November), and how big the final game install is expected to be (210GB). The final game is expected to be so big and dense with detail that no single Rockstar employee has seen the entire game , meaning there are plenty of easter eggs and ridiculous things to discover.

sources.name: Insider Gaming
sources.title: Red Dead Redemption 2 Approaches 90M Units Sold Since Launch
sources.text: Currently a bit overshadowed by the impending bombshell release of Grand Theft Auto 6 , its sister series at Rockstar, Red Dead Redemption, continues chugging along. According to Take-Two’s latest earnings report , RDR2 has nearly crossed the threshold of 90 million units sold since it was released in 2018. As it stands, the epic western RPG has sold a staggering 89 million units to date. This new sales number of 89 million units for Red Dead Redemption 2 is thoroughly impressive, as Rockstar is now nearing having two games that have broken into the extremely rare 100m+ copies sold category. In fact, in addition to GTA5, only two other titles have ever surpassed the nine-figure threshold in the history of video games: Tetris and Minecraft. While GTA5 itself sits well over 200 million copies sold to date and Red Dead Redemption 2 realistically won’t ever catch it, it’s still incredible for Rockstar to have captured this level of lightning in a bottle twice. Having the third and fourth best-selling games ever is no small feat. With Take-Two and Rockstar’s sights now firmly fixed on the release of Grand Theft Auto 6 on November 19th, there’s no telling how long Red Dead Redemption 2 can actually hold on to the fourth spot on the all-time best-selling games list. If GTA5 sales are an indicator of GTA6’s incoming popularity, it might not be long until it can catch RDR2. Still, what Red Dead Redemption 2 has managed to achieve since launch is impressive, and Rockstar doesn’t seem like they plan on slowing down any time soon. Are you one of the 89m+ who have bought RDR2, and would you theoretically be more excited for an RDR3 than GTA6? Let us know in the Insider Gaming Discord server . Getting ready for GTA6? especial_gta6.tema: O que a matéria de capa da Game Informer (setembro de 2026) revelou sobre GTA 6
especial_gta6.angulo: Resumir para o leitor brasileiro o que as 14 páginas da Game Informer acrescentaram sobre GTA 6, focando no que é novo: quem da Rockstar falou, a pesquisa na Flórida real, o norte rural de Leonida, os moradores e as atividades, sem repetir o que já saiu sobre clima e fauna.

fatos.texto: A Game Informer publicou em 29 de setembro de 2026 a edição digital de novembro de 2026 com GTA 6 na capa: uma reportagem de 14 páginas com entrevistas exclusivas com a Rockstar e 12 imagens inéditas do jogo.
A reportagem de capa se chama 'Grand Theft Auto VI: Welcome to Leonida' ('Bem-vindo a Leonida') e é centrada no estado fictício do jogo e em como a Rockstar recriou a Flórida.

Entre os entrevistados estão Aaron Garbut (co-chefe da Rockstar North), Rupert Humphries (narrativa), Paul MacPherson (vice-presidente sênior de arte de ambientes), Owen Shepherd (vice-presidente de arte de iluminação e renderização) e Michael Kane (vice-presidente de arte dinâmica).
Garbut descreveu a Flórida, principal inspiração de Leonida, como 'os Estados Unidos no volume 11' ('America dialed up to 11').
A Rockstar repetiu o que já dizia sobre o tamanho: Leonida é o maior mapa já feito pelo estúdio, cerca de duas vezes o de GTA 5, e mais denso, com mais interiores. A área exata não foi divulgada.

Mesmo com Vice City já tendo aparecido em jogos anteriores, a equipe voltou várias vezes a Miami e ao sul da Flórida: fez rondas noturnas com ex-policiais, passou noites em boates e dias nos Everglades e nas Keys, e conversou com moradores.
Para o norte de Leonida, a equipe estudou cidades reais do norte da Flórida como Jacksonville, Panama City e Ocala, além de cidadezinhas rurais entre elas.
Essa região rural do norte terá trilhas de quadriciclo, festa na lama, corridas de demolição (demolition derby) à noite, fazendas e pesca de black bass.

Perguntado sobre os parques temáticos de Orlando e a Space Coast (Cabo Canaveral), MacPherson desconversou e indicou que esses lugares exatos podem não estar no jogo; nada foi confirmado oficialmente.
Além dos bichos nativos, Leonida terá espécies invasoras que existem na Flórida real, como iguanas-verdes, gatos ferais, sapos-cururus (cane toads), tatus e macacos rhesus.

Segundo a Game Informer, os pedestres são os mais variados da série, com diferenças de altura, corpo, sardas e tatuagens, e roupas que mudam conforme a região; uma equipe da Rockstar em Los Angeles escreve as falas desses personagens.
Michael Kane disse que a equipe deu uma atenção 'absurda' às tatuagens dos personagens do jogo.

Atividades confirmadas na matéria incluem base jump, sinuca, academias, caiaque, minigolfe, mergulho, corridas de rua e off-road, visitas a zoológicos, aerobarco e jet ski; algumas podem virar encontros de Jason e Lucia.
A matéria reforçou que Jason e Lucia continuam sempre parceiros: o jogador decide se ficam só amigos ou viram casal, mas não dá para separá-los, e nenhum dos caminhos dá vantagem de jogabilidade.

Sobre o clima, Shepherd disse que o sistema foi refeito para ser mais localizado e persistente, com tempestades tropicais e furacões; a grafia do nome diverge (Kotaku escreve 'Shepard', GameSpot e Mashable 'Shepherd').
GTA 6 chega em 19 de novembro de 2026 para PS5 e Xbox Series X|S.
